prompts.text: What are you willing to struggle for?
Which costs feel empty, and which feel like the price of aliveness?
Who might you become by staying with this work?
I am building ___ because I value ___. This work is an expression of ___ and matters because ___. I am willing to carry ___ to make room for it.

blocks.title: The devotion statement
blocks.instruction: Write the devotion statement. Read it slowly. Remove any line that sounds like an announcement.

blocks.closing: Carry the sentence that feels heaviest and cleanest.
